meta.title: Daisetsuzan Kurodake Ski Area
meta.description: Ropeway to 1,984 m — alpine powder at Sounkyo, 90 minutes from Asahikawa. Daisetsuzan National Park on Kurodake's northeast face.

transit.title:
From Asahikawa,
into the alpine.
transit.lead: JR Asahikawa → Limited Express Daisetsu to Kamikawa ~40 min, then Dohoku Bus to Sounkyo ~30 min. By car: ~90 min from Asahikawa Airport, or ~30 min from Kamikawa-Sounkyo IC. Free parking for 60 vehicles.
transit.imgAlt: Snow road toward Sounkyo from Asahikawa — Daisetsuzan range ahead

primary.title: Ropeway × alpine powder
primary.lead: On the 1,984 m northeast face of Kurodake — ropeway to the 5th station, pair lift to the start. One main line branches into forest and cornice routes, up to ~30° pitch and ~1.2 km. Iconic Daisetsuzan powder and panoramas inside the national park.
primary.imgAlt: Powder slope on Daisetsuzan from Kurodake Ropeway — alpine skiing

secondary.title: After skiing, Sounkyo onsen
secondary.lead: Sounkyo Onsen lines the canyon with ryokan — snow-view baths are the classic post-ski recovery. In winter, studless tires and road conditions need a pre-trip check.

onsen.title:
Sounkyo Onsen,
canyon bath loop
onsen.lead: Ryokan along the Sounkyo gorge — many within walking distance of the ropeway base, with day-use baths for snow-view soaking.
onsen.whisper: Warm up in the hot-spring town, then pair the next day with Asahidake or wider Sounkyo sightseeing.
onsen.imgAlt: Sounkyo canyon in snow — hot-spring town along the gorge

powder.title: Daisetsuzan alpine powder
powder.body: Not a groomed wide resort — volcanic alpine terrain with dry Daisetsuzan powder. Outside the managed zone requires entry permits and registration (verify on the official site).

ropeway.title: Ropeway to the 5th station
ropeway.body: ~7 min on the Kurodake Ropeway to the 5th station, then the pair lift. Day pass (ropeway round-trip + lift) ~¥5,200 adults, ~¥2,600 children (official info — verify). Closure periods apply — check the official site before you go.

access.title: Getting there from Asahikawa
access.body: Train + bus: Asahikawa → Kamikawa ~40 min, bus to Sounkyo ~30 min. Car: ~90 min from Asahikawa Airport, ~30 min from Kamikawa-Sounkyo IC. Studless tires required in winter.

access.note: ~90 min by train + bus from JR Asahikawa, ~90 min by car from Asahikawa Airport (typical)
